variants.angle: one detail at large scale, the rest implied by the frame's edge
variants.subject: One tuned hollow of the pool, large and running off the frame's bottom edge, exploded: its body of water lifted out on the cup's axis, the inlet stone drawn out of the lip's notch, and the swell's tongue entering from the left edge along the same line.
controls: swell: the crest lines across the swell's tongue at the left edge spread apart or crowd together, about eight across it at 0.25 s and two at 8 s (position).
depth: the cup's floor drops, its far-wall meridians lengthening from a shallow saucer to a deep basin (shape of the cup, floor moves over 30 px).
salt: the standing-wave crests across the lifted water go from evenly spaced to stretched toward the rim (position of the crest lines).
drift: the lifted water slides off the cup's axis, out of register with the hollow it came from, up to about 30 px (position of the lens node).
variants.reference: library/theseus-tower (hidden-line parts over black fills, one bright rim)
variants.risks: An exploded view of a cup and a disc can read as a product drawing rather than a rock pool; the rock is carried only by the notch stone and the shelf edge. Depth reshapes the cup's meridians (one mutable outline or pre-drawn steps). The lens lifted above the cup looks like a lid; a note's answer (the lens rippling, the crests brightening) needs designing so it reads as water.

variants.angle: the object in the machine's name, drawn literally and well
variants.subject: The tide itself running up a shore: the latest swash's lacy edge as the one bright line, the sea's swell lines beyond it, broken strand marks of earlier swashes, and a rock ledge of eight hollows the water has just filled.
controls: swell: the swell lines out on the sea spread apart or crowd together toward the shore (position).
depth: the strand marks of earlier swashes stay on the beach longer, one at 50 ms up to six at 5 s (count).
salt: the eight hollows' sizes spread from a harmonic series to a stretched one, the small ones shrinking hard (scale per hollow).
drift: the hollows slide off their places on the ledge, each its own way, up to about 24 px (position per hollow).
variants.reference: opxy/reference/ (stock contour pages: one weight, value carries hierarchy)
variants.risks: Single weight leaves value alone to set the hierarchy, so the frame is busy with many grey lines of equal width; the sea lines crowd the swash on the right. The ledge with hollows is small and reads as a pasted blob at 1:1. The swash edge is ~160 points (three paths) if it should move on notes.

variants.angle: the mechanism that makes it happen: the moving parts, the thing in the hand
variants.subject: The mechanism as eight stone pipes standing in an arc in the surge, each cut to a partial's length, so every wave that blows across their mouths rings a chord; the stone's turned-away sides are hatched and the fundamental's mouth is the brightest edge.
controls: swell: the surge crests on the water in front of the pipes spread apart or crowd together (position).
depth: the pool stands higher round the pipes, the waterline rising up every pipe, over 24 px (position of the waterline).
salt: the pipes' heights stretch from a harmonic ladder to an inharmonic one, the short pipes getting shorter (shape of the skyline; each pipe a node scaled or pre-drawn).
drift: each pipe leans its own small way about its foot, tops wandering up to ~25 px (rotation per pipe).
variants.reference: library/theseus-tower (cylinders in a row, outlines over black)
variants.risks: A row of graduated cylinders can read as a bar chart or organ pipes rather than a rock pool; the arc helps but it is still close. Hatching on eight pipes is static but dense (~60 hairlines). Salt changing pipe heights needs per-pipe pre-drawn variants or scaled nodes, and scaling would thicken the hatching.

variants.angle: the material the sound acts on, seen close
variants.subject: Foam on the pool's surface seen at water level: a raft of bubbles in eight sizes, each ringing at the pitch its size sets, drawn as black domes lit only along their back edges, the largest the brightest.
controls: swell: the ripple lines running under the raft spread apart or crowd together (position).
depth: more bubbles survive in the raft, from 6 at 50 ms to 18 at 5 s (count).
salt: the bubble sizes stretch apart, the small ones shrinking toward the 3 px floor while the largest stays (scale per bubble, up to 1.6x).
drift: the bubbles jostle out of their packed places, each its own way, up to about 24 px (position per bubble).
variants.reference: opxy/reference/ (edge-lit forms) and library/toro-blocks (hollow bodies over black)
variants.risks: A bubble's own resonance is real physics, but the link from foam to tuned hollows is a step the player must take; it could read as a bath or a drink. Bright crescents on black domes can tip toward moons if the arcs get too even. The upper half of the body is empty; the raft could sit higher or bigger.

variants.angle: one scene where this happens, with one subject in it
variants.subject: One boulder at the sea's edge holding a pool in its worn top, drawn as detailed hidden-line facets, with the swell's fronts running in across the sea around it and the pool's water the brightest line.
controls: swell: the wave fronts on the sea spread apart or crowd together as they run in round the boulder (position).
depth: the pool's water sinks lower inside the rim, showing more of the inner wall, over about 20 px (position of the water ring).
salt: a band of salt crust spreads up the boulder's flank above the waterline, drawn as 45-degree hatching (hatched area).
drift: the pool's water ring tips and slides off centre inside the rim (shape of one mutable outline).
variants.reference: library/theseus-tower (detailed line art, hidden-line over black)
variants.risks: The pool is small on the boulder's top and reads partly as a collar; it needs to grow or the camera to rise. A single pool shows one hollow, not eight resonators. Depth moves the water ring only ~15-20 px at this scale, close to the floor. The facets are 40-odd hairlines; static, but count them against the node budget.
